text: I want to use numbers to check everyday problems.
A map uses two kilometres per centimetre. A trail spans five centimetres. What is its distance and why?

lesson.declared_goal: Use quantitative reasoning in everyday situations
lesson.exercise: A map uses two kilometres per centimetre. A trail spans five centimetres. What is its distance and why?
outline: Apply it to a different setting

rubric.criterion: Multiply the map length by two and report ten kilometres.
